file_format: Semicolon-delimited CSV (sep=';', decimal=',') + plain-text threshold files

modality_descriptions.BVP: Blood Volume Pulse / PPG (Empatica E4 wrist + RespiBAN optical sensor)
modality_descriptions.EDA: Electrodermal Activity / Skin Conductance (Empatica E4 + RespiBAN)

absent_modalities.ECG: Not recorded in PMPDB. Pulse rate and pulse rate variability (PRV) are extracted from BVP/PPG instead.
absent_modalities.EEG: Not recorded in PMPDB. No brain/cortical features or EEG channel explanations are claimed.

label_summary.rating_type: Discrete event-stamped NRS self-reports (1–10 scale), NOT continuous 250 Hz CoVAS
label_summary.threshold_rule_verification: 1424/1424 exact matches (0 if rate < noPainThreshold; 1 if noPainThreshold <= rate <= severePainThreshold; 2 if rate > severePainThreshold)
